verdict.rationale: Logseq stores all data as local Markdown files on the user's own device by default, which inherently gives the user full control over where their data physically resides (any folder, drive, or self-managed sync like Syncthing/git). However, there is no documented feature letting users pick a cloud region for Logseq's own official Sync service — it's described only as end-to-end encrypted, with no mention of residency options, and community comments note the official sync was buggy/immature. Missing for 10: explicit cloud region/residency selection controls, first-party documentation addressing data-residency compliance (e.g., GDPR region pinning).
